name: Delete prompt versions
description: Delete prompt versions Delete prompt versions. DELETE /api/public/v2/prompts/{promptName}
context:
DELETE /api/public/v2/prompts/{promptName}
Delete prompt versions. If neither version nor label is specified, all versions of the prompt are deleted.
Required: promptName (path) — The name of the prompt
Optional: label (query) — Optional label to filter deletion. If specified, deletes all prompt versions that have this label.; version (query) — Optional version to filter deletion. If specified, deletes only this specific version of the prompt.

name: Get a prompt
context:
GET /api/public/v2/prompts/{promptName}
Get a prompt
Required: promptName (path) — The name of the prompt. If the prompt is in a folder (e.g., "folder/subfolder/prompt-name"), the folder path must be URL encoded.
Optional: version (query) — Version of the prompt to be retrieved.; label (query) — Label of the prompt to be retrieved. Defaults to "production" if no label or version is set.; resolve (query) — Resolve prompt dependencies before returning the prompt. Defaults to `true`. Set to `false` to return the raw stored prompt with dependency tags intact. This bypasses prompt caching and is intended for debugging or one-off jobs, not production runtime fetches.
